Hon'ble Chandra Dhari Singh,J.

The instant criminal revision has been filed against the judgment and order dated 29.04.2008 passed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Court no.3, Pratapgarh in Criminal Appeal No.07 of 2006 (Mewa Lal vs. State of U.P.) dismissing the appeal and upholding the judgment and order dated 05.05.2006 passed by the learned Judicial Magistrate, Kunda Pratapgarh in Criminal Case No.57 of 2003 (State vs. Mewa Lal) under section 16(1-A) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act and sentenced to undergo six months rigorous imprisonment with a fine of Rs.1000/- and in default of payment of fine, further undergo one month additional imprisonment.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the revisionist has argued only on the sentence.
He has submitted that the revisionist has been convicted and sentenced as above.
The incident is of 21.06.1989.
The Judicial Magistrate, Kunda, Pratapgarh has passed the conviction order in criminal case no. 57 of 2003 (State vs. Mewa Lal).

sentences.text: It is also submitted that the revisionist has already undergone sufficient period.
He is first time offender, therefore, the present revision may be decided on the basis of period already undergone by the accused-revisionist.

Learned Additional Government Advocate vehemently opposed the submissions raised on behalf of the revisionist and submitted that after considering the facts and material on record the Judicial Magistrate, Pratapgarh has rightly convicted the revisionist and awarded appropriate sentence as stated above.
The appellate court has also after perusing the entire facts and circumstances affirmed the order passed by the Judicial Magistrate, Kunda Pratapgarh.
I have heard the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and perused the record.

Since the revisionist counsel without entering into the merits of the case has requested that the revision may be decided on the basis of period already undergone by the revisionist, I find that the incident is of 1989 and already 30 years had gone, therefore, this Court finds that it would be appropriate to dispose of this revision on the basis of period already undergone by the revisionist.
In view of the fact and circumstances stated herein above, the present criminal revision is partly allowed.

The conviction for the offences punishable under section under section 16(1-A) of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act is maintained, however, the sentence is reduced to the period already undergone by him.
The fine as awarded by the court below should be deposited within two months' from today, if the same had not been deposited.
In case of default of payment of fine within the period specified by this Court, the revisionist shall undergo one month's simple imprisonment.
Fine, if any, already deposited by the revisionist, shall be adjusted by the trial court.
The revisionist is on bail.
He need not surrender in case he is not wanted in any other case.
His bail bonds are hereby cancelled.
Sureties are discharged from their liability.
Record of the lower court, if summoned, shall be remitted back to the court concerned forthwith along with the copy of this order.

Order Date :- 18.7.2019 VNP/-
